name: fix-map-trapped
about: 'The chest was trapped!!' (bugs 10.22.26 line 41, mods/keys Trapped.as): on a keep floor a cursed chest (items/chests/chest_cursed.unit, the one whose loot roll is the shade ambush) is spawned beside the player and opened; the host logs the opening, broadcasts keys.trapped, and this machine (within 900 px) shows the hwp_trapped announce (arial24, mid-screen, 2 s, trip-wire sound) and logs the banner. A shot catches the banner. The bot then opens a second cursed chest 1500 px away: the event arrives but is out of range (no banner, logged as such), and a plain chest never logs. Mods core + keys. About 3 minutes.

steps.name: the keys chest class is live (its Use calls the trap hook)
a cursed chest beside the player
opened (IUsable.Use from where the player stands)
the host recognised the cursed chest
this machine showed the banner (keys.trapped event in range)
the announce style loaded from tweak/hwp/announce_keys.sval
range rule and a plain chest
